body.purpose: Editorial copy and case study prose.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Subtle hover lift for gallery cards and modal dialog sheets.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential deceleration for route fades and image hover scale.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action and form submission trigger.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink, #141413); color: var(--paper, #f7f6f2); padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent, #1e40af); color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action on paper and stone surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--surface-pure, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #141413); padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #c4bfb4); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface, #efece6); border-color: var(--ink, #141413); }

components.name: Accent Chip
components.description: Category tag on featured specimens and project ledger rows.
components.css: .ds-chip-accent { display: inline-block; font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--accent-soft, #e8eef9); color: var(--accent, #1e40af); border: 1px solid rgba(30, 64, 175, 0.25); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form input for search, contact inquiries, and CMS editing.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #c4bfb4); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--paper, #f7f6f2); color: var(--ink, #141413); font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #1e40af); background: var(--surface-pure, #ffffff); }

components.name: Gallery Card
components.description: Framed visual artwork card opening the lightbox dialog.
components.css: .ds-gallery-card { border: 1px solid var(--rule, #ddd9d0); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-pure, #ffffff); overflow: hidden; } .ds-gallery-body { padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--ink, #141413); }

narrative.overview: This design system treats a multidisciplinary developer-designer portfolio and its built-in CMS like a clean architectural monograph printed on warm uncoated paper. Light mode is the primary surface, relying on generous whitespace, crisp 1px rules, and unembellished ImageKit imagery so real projects and gallery works command attention from the first viewport.
keyCharacteristics: Light-mode-first warm paper ground (#F7F6F2) with optional dark mode (#121210)
Self-hosted display, UI, and monospace typography with zero third-party font stylesheets
Single-pixel hairline boundaries (#DDD9D0) separating ledgers, tables, and specimens
Native <dialog> case-study sheets and gallery lightbox with keyboard navigation

rules.name: The Light-First Ink Rule
rules.body: Default to warm archival paper (#F7F6F2) and dark graphite ink (#141413); reserve cobalt (#1E40AF) strictly for interactive affordances, active page states, and featured tags.

rules.name: The Self-Contained Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings speak on their own without eyebrow kickers or section numbers above them, keeping more vertical space above each heading than below it.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with 1px rules and tonal contrast before reaching for shadows; never use hard zero-blur offset block shadows.

dos: Do deliver all ImageKit images with ?tr=w-...,q-80,f-auto transforms to protect free-tier bandwidth.
Do keep ::selection, caret-color, :focus-visible, and scrollbars themed to the paper/cobalt palette.
Do build dynamic DOM nodes with document.createElement and textContent rather than innerHTML.
donts: Don't add eyebrow kickers or numeric prefixes (01, 02) above headings.
Don't use gradient text, blurred ambient orbs, or identical icon-card grids.
Don't ship external Google Fonts stylesheets or place private API keys in client-side code.
